lexicon.clay-legion.title: Clay Lexicon
lexicon.clay-legion.intro.title: Welcome, Commander
lexicon.clay-legion.intro.body1: Clay soldiers are tiny warriors that fight for their team the moment they touch the ground. Place dolls to muster armies, then arm them by dropping items nearby.
lexicon.clay-legion.intro.body2: Soldiers pick up upgrades from the ground, ride mounts into battle, and drop everything they carried when they fall - including their doll, which teammates can resurrect.
lexicon.clay-legion.intro.body3: Right-click a soldier with an empty hand to possess it and take direct control. Sneak to return to your body.
lexicon.clay-legion.teams.title: Teams
lexicon.clay-legion.mounts.title: Mounts
lexicon.clay-legion.mounts.horse: • Horse: sturdy all-round mount crafted from a box of material around soul sand.
lexicon.clay-legion.mounts.pegasus: • Pegasus: a horse crowned with a feather; carries soldiers over gaps.
lexicon.clay-legion.mounts.turtle: • Turtle: slow and tanky; shrugs off part of the damage aimed at its rider.
lexicon.clay-legion.mounts.bunny: • Bunny: light and quick, crafted from colored wool.
lexicon.clay-legion.mounts.gecko: • Gecko: wall-happy lizard grown from saplings.
lexicon.clay-legion.upgrade.bone: +3 damage, 30 uses. Too heavy to carry while riding.
lexicon.clay-legion.upgrade.blazerod: +1 damage, 20 uses. Sets victims on fire.
lexicon.clay-legion.upgrade.gold_melon: Healer's blade, 20 uses. Heals critical targets instead of finishing them.
lexicon.clay-legion.upgrade.shear_right: +1 damage, 25 uses. Strikes harder on the first hit. Take a second pair to dual-wield.
lexicon.clay-legion.upgrade.wood_button: Brawler: +1 unarmed damage. No weapons allowed.
lexicon.clay-legion.upgrade.stone_button: Brawler: +2 unarmed damage. No weapons allowed.
lexicon.clay-legion.upgrade.bowl: Shield: -1 damage taken per hit, consumes durability.
lexicon.clay-legion.upgrade.nether_quart: Shockwave shield, 4 uses. Five rapid hits trigger a knockback blast.
lexicon.clay-legion.upgrade.gravel: Throwing rocks that shove targets backwards.
lexicon.clay-legion.upgrade.snow: Snowballs that chill and slow targets.
lexicon.clay-legion.upgrade.emerald: Piercing shard: punches through armor and the first victim.
lexicon.clay-legion.upgrade.iron_ingot: Heavy core: resists knockback and doubles knockback dealt.
lexicon.clay-legion.upgrade.brick: Turret mode: immovable, rooted in place.
lexicon.clay-legion.upgrade.nether_brick: Burns attackers that strike in melee.
lexicon.clay-legion.upgrade.flint: +2 damage. Requires a stick to strap it to.
lexicon.clay-legion.upgrade.gold_ingot: +1 damage, -1 damage taken, doubles all durability. Kings only.
lexicon.clay-legion.upgrade.iron_block: -1 damage taken. Requires a bowl shield.
lexicon.clay-legion.upgrade.wool: -1 damage taken. Requires leather or rabbit hide padding.
lexicon.clay-legion.upgrade.rotten_flesh: Mob hunter: also attacks hostile monsters.
lexicon.clay-legion.upgrade.ferm_spider_: Retaliator: only fights when attacked first.
lexicon.clay-legion.upgrade.sponge: Invisible to soldier AI, and ignores everyone.
lexicon.clay-legion.upgrade.diamond: +10 max health, +speed, full heal, doubles all durability.
lexicon.clay-legion.upgrade.diamond_bloc: +80 max health, +speed, full heal, 5x all durability.
lexicon.clay-legion.upgrade.glass: Goggles: +16 sight range, sees through egg stealth.
lexicon.clay-legion.upgrade.sugar: Speed boost. Don't mix with diamonds.
lexicon.clay-legion.upgrade.feather: Parachute: no fall damage, gentle descent.
lexicon.clay-legion.upgrade.blaze_powder: 1 use. Instantly immolates the next victim.
lexicon.clay-legion.upgrade.redstone: 4 uses. Blinds targets, who lose their aggression.
lexicon.clay-legion.upgrade.clay_ball: 4 uses. Revives fallen clay soldiers from their dolls.
lexicon.clay-legion.upgrade.ender_pearl: Zombification: +5 health, raises fallen soldiers onto your team. Decays after 10 minutes.
lexicon.clay-legion.upgrade.magma_cream: Time bomb: a melee killer inherits a ticking fuse.
lexicon.clay-legion.upgrade.firework_roc: 1 use. Rockets away when badly hurt.
lexicon.clay-legion.upgrade.egg: Stealth: invisible to enemies without goggles.
lexicon.clay-legion.upgrade.concrete_pow: Dyes the cape. Requires a cape to dye.
